sources.entry: Hyperkey - Turn Caps Lock or another modifier into a Hyper key. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Hyperkey
summary.one_liner: Hyperkey is a free macOS utility that turns Caps Lock or another modifier key into a Hyper key, which sends all four modifiers (⌃⌥⌘⇧) at once.
use_cases: Assign Caps Lock as a Hyper key for app shortcuts
Trigger Rectangle window management shortcuts with one key
Remap Caps Lock to a more useful key
Create global shortcuts in Keyboard Maestro using a Hyper key
summary.what_it_does: Hyperkey converts Caps Lock or any other modifier key into a Hyper key that combines Control, Option, Command and Shift. The Hyper key works as an extra modifier in any app that supports keyboard shortcuts. It can also be used simply to remap Caps Lock to a different key. The page describes it as a lightweight companion for Rectangle and other apps. It states that Keyboard Maestro shortcuts can be triggered by the Hyper key if the shortcut is recorded by pressing the modifiers physically.
notable: Combines ⌃⌥⌘⇧ into a single Hyper key
Works with Rectangle and other shortcut-based apps
Supports macOS 10.15+ on Intel and Apple Silicon
Upgrade path to paid Superkey, which adds click-text-with-keyboard features
caveats: Key remappings do not work in macOS secure password fields
Keyboard Maestro shortcut recording needs the modifiers pressed physically
Superkey, a paid upgrade, is required for keyboard-driven text clicking
